description: This file defines the class UpgradeCommands which extends Robo Tasks for performing automated upgrade commands in SuiteCRM. It contains properties and a method to execute a silent upgrade process.

classes.name: UpgradeCommands
classes.description: A Robo task class providing commands for upgrading SuiteCRM, including executing silent upgrades with specified parameters.

methods.name: upgradeSuite
methods.description: Performs a SuiteCRM upgrade by setting properties and executing a PHP script for silent upgrade.
